title: KB90 PM Runbook
subtitle: La Marzocco KB90 | preventive maintenance kits and steps
sources: La Marzocco USA preventative maintenance checklists v2.1 (May 2026): 3/9-month, 6-month and 12-month. Kit numbers are per visit and group count. La Marzocco does not print kit contents on the checklists; where a kit note lists contents it comes from the checklist's replace list or LM's annual PM summary. Confirm kit numbers with La Marzocco USA before ordering. KB90 kit contents: LM KB90 PM summary v2.0 (Dec 2020).

banners.text: One kit per visit. The 3/9-month PM is the same visit at month 3 and month 9; the 6- and 12-month kits are complete for their visit, so earlier kits are not added.
3/9-month PM: La Marzocco lists loose parts for this visit, not a kit. Quantities are one per group.
The 12-month checklist prints the 3-group kit as KB90.X.12.3. It is listed here as KB90.12.3; confirm with La Marzocco when ordering.

items.text: Test the water before and after the filter with the LM test kit (F.9.000.01). Record the filter make and type and compare with the limits in Reference.
Replace the diffuser screens and the group gaskets and bumpers on every group.
Fit the parts in the PM kit.
Check the filter baskets and springs.
Confirm the auto flush system works.
Check the portafilter jaw bushings.
Check the Straight-In piston for leaks under pressure.
Check the group cap micro switches.
Test every button.
Measure each flow meter's field resistance: 2.2 kΩ ±10% (1.98–2.42 kΩ). Record G1–G3 in kΩ.
Check the flow meter impellers.
Record each group's flow rate in AV mode: grams in 30 s, G1–G3.
Record each group's brewing pressure (bar).
Check the expansion valves and record each group's maximum pressure (bar).
Check the steam valves work.
Clean the auto-fill probe.
Check all fittings and valves for leaks.
Check the vacuum breakers work.
Check the water sensor for leaks.
Check the water and drain lines, drain box and hose for leaks or clogs.
Check the power cord, cap and outlet.
Check the wiring harness and components.
Check the electronics box for water or damage.
Run the ABR scale test.
Confirm or calibrate the scales with a 100 g weight.
Fill in the La Marzocco checklist for this visit: serial, voltage, group count and every reading. Get the customer's signature.

reference.title: Water limits (LM test kit F.9.000.01)
reference.text: Test before and after the filter. Record the filter make and type: carbon, ion exchange/softener, WAC, reverse osmosis, or none.

reference.title: Specs on the checklists
list: Flow meter field resistance: 2.2 kΩ ±10% (1.98–2.42 kΩ).
Flow rate: the checklist header says ml/30 s but the blanks say g. Record grams in 30 s and note it.
Brew pressure, expansion valve max pressure and boiler temperature: the checklists give blanks, no targets. Use the machine manual's settings.
Integrated scales: confirm or calibrate with a 100 g weight.
